scope_statement: With this feature we verify that FX_SPOT type instruments are correctly displayed in instrument suggestion in dxTrade5 widgets.
checklist_notes:
Good: 
  - division by widget
  - division by individual "rules subsets" that define general function
  - further division into atomic checks for each rules subset
  - negative and positive scenarios, edge cases
  - links to design docs
  - no reference of Adaptive because the epic is not related to it
reference_checklist:
## Instrument Suggestion – “All” Tab
- Verify FX_SPOT instruments appear in the 'All' tab across all instrument suggestions:
>**Design**: [Link to Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/DNmyG15cyGltqx7x5GY9C1/CornerBank-WebTrader-Dark?node-id=15389-94878&t=y3zWvKsE4KnREXee-0)
>**dxTrade5/WebBroker widgets**: Order Entry, Time and Sales, Watchlist, Alerts, Derivatives, Risk Profile
- Verify FX_SPOT instruments are displayed when searching by: Symbol, Description, Partial string (matching substrings are highlighted)
- Verify search is case-insensitive (lowercase, uppercase, mixed case) and description with whitespaces (e.g.  "Euro vs")
- Verify the following columns are displayed: Symbol, Description, Type (FX Spot), Exchange (Empty)
- Verify data matches IPF (Symbol, Description)
- Verify no duplicate or inconsistent entries appear in results
## Instrument Suggestion – “FX Spot” Tab
- Verify FX_SPOT instruments appear in the 'FX Spot' tab across all instrument suggestions:
>**Design**: [Link to Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/DNmyG15cyGltqx7x5GY9C1/CornerBank-WebTrader-Dark?node-id=15389-94878&t=y3zWvKsE4KnREXee-0)
>**dxTrade5/WebBroker widgets**: Order Entry, Time and Sales, Watchlist, Alerts, Derivatives, Risk Profile
- Verify the 'FX Spot' tab exists and is clickable
- Verify only FX_SPOT instruments are displayed in this tab
- Verify correct behavior when no search query is entered (_Start typing to find instruments…_)
- Verify FX_SPOT instruments are displayed when searching by: Symbol, Description, Partial string (matching substrings are highlighted)
- Verify search is case-insensitive (lowercase, uppercase, mixed case) and description with whitespaces (e.g.  "Euro vs")
- Verify the following columns are displayed: Symbol, Description, Exchange (Empty)
- Verify data matches IPF (Symbol, Description)
- Verify no duplicate or inconsistent entries appear in results
- Verify appropriate message is displayed when no FX_SPOT instruments match the search criteria. (_No symbol matches your search criteria. Try to specify your request._)
- Verify data is consistent between 'All' and 'FX Spot' tabs
- Verify FX_SPOT instruments are visible and selectable for account with different trading permissions (Full trading, Close Only, No Trading, FX Spot instruments not allowed)
## Column Filter – Instrument
- Verify FX_SPOT search filter works correctly in the Instrument column across all relevant widgets
>**dxTrade5 widgets:** Account Transactions, Orders, Positions, Trades, Trading Journal
>**webBroker widgets:** Order Book, Position Book, Transactions
- Verify searching by: Full symbol, Partial string
- Verify matching instruments appear in “Found” results
- Verify displayed instruments include correct “FX Spot” type label
- Verify only relevant results are returned after filtering
## Column Filter – Symbol
- Verify FX_SPOT search filter works correctly in the Symbol column across all relevant widgets
>**dxTrade5 widgets:** Account Transactions, Orders, Positions, Trades, Trading Journal
>**webBroker widgets:** Order Book, Position Book, Transactions
- Verify searching by: Full symbol, Partial string
- Verify matching instruments appear in “Found” results
- Verify displayed instruments include correct “FX Spot” type label
- Verify only relevant results are returned after filtering
## Column Filter – Instrument Type
- Verify the FX_SPOT filter works correctly in the 'Instrument Type' column across all relevant widgets
>**dxTrade5 widgets:** Orders, Positions, Trades, Trading Journal
>**webBroker widgets:** Order Book, Position Book, Transactions
- Verify “FX Spot” appears in the Instrument Type dropdown
- Verify it is placed correctly in alphabetical order
- Verify selecting “FX Spot”: Filters table to only FX_SPOT instruments
- Verify selecting “FX Spot” + other types: Displays combined results correctly
- Verify all FX_SPOT rows display “FX Spot” in Instrument Type column
